title: UK hotel worker loses court claims; booked a 4-week holiday without permission
summary_full: Dylan Forster, an employee at Inn on the Lake, unilaterally booked a trip to South Africa, despite not receiving permission for a four-week leave due to hotel policies and staffing requirements. Upon resigning, he raised grievances about discrimination and injury. However, an employment tribunal concluded that his claims were baseless, confirming the hotel's adherence to its protocols and reasonable actions.
